seoTitle: Stopwatch with Laps and CSV Export
metaDescription: Time events with laps, splits and cumulative times and download the laps as a CSV file. Free, in your browser.
intro: A stopwatch with start, stop, lap and reset, and a button to download all laps as a CSV file.
why:
Timing a run, a speech or a test is more useful when the laps are saved. The CSV has lap number, split and total in mm:ss.hh and in seconds.

It uses a high-resolution browser clock. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.a: Display updates every 50 ms; the clock itself is more precise. Browser tabs in the background may update less often.
Your browser downloads folder as laps.csv.
No, laps vanish when you leave the page.
